model.name: IOR carries a clear ORIGIN (class + host + unit-path) for cross-instance DnD, reconciled with the federated ior:instance:<uuid>@<originHost> scheme (single origin format, no fork)
model.description: For cross-instance drag-and-drop (WODA.prod <-> WODA.test) an IOR must carry a CLEAR ORIGIN so the source unit resolves unambiguously: its class + origin HOST + unit path (Tron's example: ior:class:WebItem://prod.wo-da.de:4444/scenario/index/.../dfa9263a....scenario.json). ★ RECONCILE, do NOT fork (single-source law): the EXISTING federated IOR scheme is ior:instance:<uuid>@<originHost> (+ model.originHost / model.originIor, design-notes/federated-scenario-transfer.md). The unit PATH is DERIVABLE from the uuid (deterministic sharding index/c0/c1/c2/c3/c4/<uuid>.scenario.json) and the CLASS from the resolved unit — so ONE origin format (uuid@host) carries class+host+path by-reference. The architect designs the exact reconciliation; a SECOND origin format is forbidden.
model.tronQuote: > Tron: "To drag and drop between the WODA.prod and the WODA.test instance IORs have to be enhanced." / "it should have a clear origin." (example: ior:class:WebItem://prod.wo-da.de:4444/scenario/index/.../.scenario.json).

discoverySource.note: Cluster C. Reconcile with existing federated IOR (do NOT fork a 2nd origin format).

acceptanceCriteria.text: A cross-instance IOR carries a CLEAR ORIGIN — class + origin HOST + unit path — so a prod<->test DnD resolves the source unit unambiguously ('it should have a clear origin').

The origin RECONCILES with the EXISTING federated IOR ior:instance:<uuid>@<originHost> (+ model.originHost/originIor) — do NOT fork a 2nd origin format (single-source). Path derived from uuid-sharding, class from the resolved unit => ONE format carries class+host+path by-reference. Local IORs omit @host (back-compatible).
A unit dragged from WODA.prod dropped on WODA.test resolves via its origin (fetch by-reference through the federated scheme), NOT a plain-URL WebItem (the A2 defect at instance scope).
[DEVICE-ONLY @390 pixel — Tron, NEVER headless-green, TRON-ONLY] Tron verifies a prod<->test drop carries the origin and resolves the real unit.

model.crossRefNote: Reconciles with the federated-scenario-transfer.md scheme (ior:instance:<uuid>@<originHost>). Ties to cluster A (A2 URL-not-unit is the local case; C is the cross-instance case). Single origin format, no fork.
